content: This paper presents a novel methodology for jointly performing feature selection and classification of longitudinal functional data with categorical outcomes, addressing a new optimization problem that combines logistic loss and functional features to identify key predictors. The approach uses functional principal components and an adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm to efficiently handle high-dimensional data, demonstrating its effectiveness through simulations and a real-world analysis of chronic diseases and socio-demographic factors.
